decisions.reason: As a newly launched but highly core two-component resin injection unit in a long-life industrial equipment portfolio, it is likely to be retained unless it clearly overlaps with another model.

This product fits the firm's established resin-processing business, though the presence of another new two-component unit creates a modest risk of later portfolio consolidation rather than immediate withdrawal.
An automatic airless spray gun is central to the firm's application technology range, so a medium-sized German machinery maker would usually keep it on the market beyond its first year.
A manual airless spray gun is a standard, complementary product for industrial coating users and is unlikely to be removed so soon after launch.
The air-assisted airless spray gun matches the firm's precision-coating positioning and should remain part of the offering unless early demand proves unexpectedly weak.
The data logger supports equipment monitoring and service differentiation, but as a more peripheral digital accessory than the core hardware lines it carries somewhat higher discontinuation risk.
